technique_name: Generate a creative recipe for chocolate cookie.
description: This delicious recipe for Chocolate Kiss Crinkle Cookies is sure to please! Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Next, cream together 1/2 cup butter and 1/2 cup granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Add 1/2 cup packed brown sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract and beat until well combined.
